name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region on 28 Nov; UK snow this month stayed at yellow
state: The Met Office's yellow snow warning for southern Scotland and northern and central England on 17 Nov, alongside a UKHSA yellow cold-health alert, was the UK's main winter alert this month (Met Office, 16 Nov). Searches on 28 Nov found no top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region in Europe, North America or Asia, and no cold-related power or gas outages, so Normal holds.
for_you: No major cold wave is under way. Met Office warnings and UKHSA cold-health alerts are the official guides as winter begins; older people and those with heart or lung conditions are most exposed to cold.
rubric_hit: Normal: no top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region found on 28 Nov

sources.title: Met Office — Snow warning in force as unsettled weather continues

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
